C9000360.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 360 (Weak MTW curvature gives convexity and regular optimal transport.; papers: Global Support and Convex Injectivity Domains under Weak MTW; Uniform Bi-Holder Transport from Weak MTW; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/360.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ACTIVE_HULL.statement: Foundation geo:prelim: arbitrary continuous representing data give a compact active-log graph and ordinary subdifferential equal to its convex hull.

C_RADIAL_DIVIDED.statement: Foundation geo:radial-index: strict divided-action radial decrease with a geometric positive constant.

C_TRANSVERSE_SLACK.statement: Foundation geo:slack: transverse MTW Jensen and radial decrease extend to a nonconjugate critical center branch.

C_LOCAL_INJECTIVITY_CORE.statement: Arbitrary moving finite-slot cancellation with uniformly vanishing normalized remainders excludes a positive limiting quadratic gap, including vanishing weights.

C_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_BRIDGE.statement: The arbitrary-continuous-datum geometry supplies all moving-slot scalar hypotheses using only subcritical interiority at the limiting base point.

C_LOCAL_FIBER_THEOREM.statement: At a nonconjugate graph point, subcritical interiority of its single limiting subgradient fiber suffices for local projection injectivity.

C_FIBER_GEOMETRIC_BRIDGE.statement: Compact active data, proper radial supports and transverse concavity only on the limiting contracted fiber supply the collision hypotheses without global weak MTW.

C_FIBER_LOCAL_REDUCTION.statement: On a connected compact smooth manifold, a nonconjugate critical center and subcritical interiority plus transverse Hessian concavity at its one limiting fiber imply local graph projection injectivity.

C_LOCAL_INJECTIVITY.statement: Literal foundation geo:local-injectivity for arbitrary continuous representing data, moving active logarithms and weights tending to zero.

C_SHORT_TIME.statement: Foundation geo:short-time: semiconvex graph charts and the short-time projection homeomorphism.

C_MINIMIZER_CAPTURE.statement: Foundation geo:minimizer-capture: all minimizing velocities at a minimizing pole are ordinary subgradients.

C_SEGMENT_NONCONJ.statement: Foundation prop:segment-nonconjugacy: a minimizing segment with nonconjugate endpoints is entirely nonconjugate.

C_HULL_NONCONJ.statement: Foundation geo:first-cut: a minimizing finite hull with nonconjugate generators is entirely nonconjugate.

C_COVERING_HOMEOMORPHISM.statement: Foundation lem:covering-homeomorphism: a locally injective compact-manifold map homotopic to a homeomorphism is a homeomorphism.

C_FOUNDATION_SUPPORT.statement: Foundation geo:support and thm:foundation(i): global support and all intermediate graph homeomorphisms.

C_FOUNDATION_CONVEXITY.statement: Foundation thm:main and geo:convexity: weak MTW implies convex closed minimizing and open injectivity domains.

C_FOUNDATION_SECTIONS.statement: Foundation geo:sections and thm:foundation(ii): compact convex lifted dual-gap sections and their diameter bound.

C_FOUNDATION_INTERMEDIATE.statement: Foundation geo:intermediate and thm:foundation(iii): density-free intermediate C1,1 duality, pole control and quadratic growth.

C_TRANSPORT_SPECTRAL.statement: Transport spec:identities, spec:radial, spec:radial-determinants, spec:pullback, spec:comparison and spec:outward.

C_TRANSPORT_SCALES.statement: Transport sc:plateau, sc:templates, sc:switch, sc:excess, sc:maximum, sc:parameter, sc:levels and sc:outward.

C_TRANSPORT_JETS.statement: Transport jet:contact-volume, jet:viscosity, jet:transfer, jet:semibound, jet:outer-conjugacy, jet:outer-test, jet:subgradient-differential and jet:determinants.

C_TRANSPORT_MATRIX.statement: Transport jet:matrix and jet:contradiction: determinant amplification contradicts density bounds and gives a section-oscillation power bound.

C_TRANSPORT_MAIN.statement: Transport thm:main via sc:power: class-uniform global bi-Holder optimal transport for bounded positive densities on a fixed weak-MTW manifold.

C_PRIOR_MOVING_CALCULUS.statement: Known upstream generic moving-parameter cancellation and its finite-family geometric integration boundary.
